body:
# 🎉 Welcome to the Atlas!
We are absolutely thrilled to announce the official launch of the Atlas Discord Community, the premier hub for the entire gaming and Minecraft community!

## When will Atlas open?
Atlas expo will be opening soon! While our server is still being worked on check out [Bundle Parks](https://modrinth.com/server/bundle-parks)!

## What is Atlas?
Atlas is the revitalised and expanded evolution of Coasters & Crafters. Our mission is simple: to provide a vibrant, high visibility platform where the incredible talent within Minecraft can connect, advertise and grow.

## Who Should Join Atlas?
Atlas is built to serve the creators, developers and community leaders who power the Minecraft world. If you are involved in building, running or promoting gaming content, this is your place!
- 💻 Plugin & Mod Developers
- 🎨 Modelers & Artists
- 🏰 Server Owners & Communities
- 📢 Content Creators

## Website!
Our website will be relaunching soon and both your Coasters & Crafters Community and your Coasters & Crafters Accounts will be migrating. We will keep you up to date as changes are made!
Please use https://coastersandcrafters.com/ in the meantime!
